verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents a broad REST API, published as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec. It covers order submission (Checkout/Sale), decision retrieval, chargebacks, representment outcomes, guarantee cancellation and webhook creation. Nothing states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, though. Decision Center policies are described as configured at checkpoints rather than through API calls, and some Enterprise API docs sit behind the app login. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of Decision Center policy configuration and other dashboard/admin functions, ungated Enterprise API docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
